instruction: I need to disable global hotkeys in VLC Media Player. Specifically, I want to turn off the global play/pause hotkey so it doesn't interfere with other applications on my system.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the global play/pause hotkey in VLC. The evaluator uses the existing check_global_key_play_pause metric to verify that the global-key-play-pause setting is empty (indicated by value 0). Similar difficulty to the original - navigating to hotkey preferences and disabling a specific global hotkey.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts VLC config file (vlcrc) from OS-specific location
Metric correctly checks global-key-play-pause setting in config file
Logic correctly interprets empty value (after '=') as disabled (0) vs set as enabled (1)
Expected value 0 semantically correct - means global play/pause hotkey is disabled/empty
Postconfig appropriately kills and relaunches VLC to ensure config is persisted to disk before verification
Complete instruction coverage - verifies the specific requirement to disable global play/pause hotkey
Robust error handling for file not found and parsing exceptions
